title: Speaking in a Language: The Suffix -ul/-ül

sections.content:
In Hungarian, when you say you speak, learn, or read *in* a language, you attach the essive-modal suffix **-ul / -ül** to the name of the language or country:
- Back vowels take **-ul**: *magyar → magyarul* (in Hungarian), *angol → angolul* (in English), *spanyol → spanyolul* (in Spanish), *olasz → olaszul* (in Italian).
- Front vowels take **-ül**: *német → németül* (in German), *török → törökül* (in Turkish), *görög → görögül* (in Greek).

items.english: Yes, I speak a little Hungarian.

sections.content: For *francia* (French), the final short -a lengthens to -á before the suffix: *franciául*.
